title: b7z9.37.3(ii): wire RootSeqCache into RplStack DODAG state
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.3. LANDS AFTER sibling (i). Placement test root_seq_cache_is_reachable_from_stack_state: accept via stack state, read-back, replay rejection leaves state untouched, per-key isolation. Full lichen-node lib tests 294 pass (incl. new); my diff fmt-clean. Pre-existing failures on this branch triaged and NOT caused by this diff (reproduced with diff stashed): rfc6554_route_crosses panics InvalidSourceRoute (filed as new bead, dedup-checked), util.rs fmt hunks (kpv0.5 scope, deferred until b7z9.4.2 lands), secure.rs:642 clippy too_many_arguments (kpv0.6 scope). 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (all 4 construction paths covered — reviewer counted; visibility sound; expect-bridge reasoning verified vs rust-version 1.81), security PASS (only caller is the test; no production path admits unverified seqs today; expect scoped to single method), edge PASS with one scope handoff: post-reboot replay window documented and routed to b7z9.37.1 via comment (persistence decision explicit, not dropped).
